# Test tooling for the uv `mindep` CI variant. The scenario installs core
# ObsPy only (via `.`, i.e. install_requires) plus these test runners, with NO
# optional feature dependencies (no cartopy, geographiclib, pyshp, pyproj, ...).
# This is the pip/uv counterpart of .github/test_mindep_conda_env.yml -- keep
# the two in sync.
pytest
pytest-cov
pytest-json-report>=1.4
